claims.statement: Tracera declares React Flow, Sigma/Graphology, Cytoscape and ELK; dependency presence does not prove integration.
The existing Store boundary names PostgreSQL and SQLite; TraceLink has no explicit endpoint revision, configuration or authority fields.
query_intents does not use ProductQuery.product_id; invalid kind/status strings parse to None, effectively removing those filters. Caller isolation remains unverified.
Kuzu upstream is archived; LadybugDB has a current non-archived repository and exposes Rust bindings, but requires concurrency and lifecycle qualification.
Keep SQLite/PostgreSQL as the low-rewrite baseline; benchmark alternative engines behind a port instead of moving canonical truth immediately.
Use compiler/indexer-backed SCIP for symbol references, tree-sitter for syntax, native build metadata for build topology; none establishes requirement satisfaction by itself.
Separate authoring, broad exploration and algorithm/layout responsibilities; do not make renderer state the product authority.
Borrow structured visible feedback from educational graders, but do not equate a display status, score override or historical best score with current product acceptance.
RIG findings concern structural questions and a partly manually constructed corpus; they do not establish general coding productivity or an automatic Cargo/npm adapter.
TraceDev is relevant prior art for trace-guided multi-agent feedback, but its generated tests and semantic LLM judging need independent oracle controls in a Tracera pilot.
Measure retrieval, patch acceptance and maintenance effort separately rather than promoting file-level recall into product success.
RDF/PROV/SHACL adapters may reuse Oxigraph subcrates without committing the canonical store to an RDF-only architecture.

access_limitations: Container outbound GitHub DNS failed; connector/web reads succeeded. No clone/build/download benchmark claimed.
